$comment: Registry of decisions for public --dx-* custom properties flagged by tools/review/reachability.mjs (declared and never read inside the built fluent-next bundle — tools/review/unread-tier.json) or by publicSurfaceUnused in tests/fluent-next-naming.test.ts (declared in some theme's source, never referenced by apps/demos/Demos, packages/devextreme/js or scss/widgets/base). A flagged name that stays public goes in `kept` here, with the reason a human decided to keep it despite the gate not seeing a consumer. A name retired instead is recorded in tools/naming/public-renames.json, not here — the two files are mutually exclusive. `pending` lists flagged names still under individual review (see the ticket's own working notes) — every name either gate flags must end up in exactly one of `kept`, `pending`, or public-renames.json's `retired`; tests/public-surface-allowlist.test.ts enforces that.

fields.name: The kept name, exactly as it ships.
fields.reason: Why a human decided to keep publishing it despite the gate finding no consumer.
fields.since: The date the decision was recorded.
